text.p: Lufthansa unit CityLine said on Friday that it placed a firm follow-on order for three additional Canadair Regional Jet aircraft and options for three more from Bombardier Inc's Regional Aircraft Division.
The value of the three firm orders is about US$70 million. Deliveries are scheduled for March 1997 and January and February 1998.

"The Canadair Jet, at 50 seats, has allowed us to open new and profitable non-stop routes between secondary cities within Germany and between Germany and several other countries," said Lufthansa CityLine Managing Director Karl-Friedrich Rausch.
"The Canadair Jet's size allows Lufthansa CityLine to economically bypass congested hubs such as Frankfurt, providing our passengers with more convenient point-to-point service," he said.
Lufthansa CityLine offers Canadair Regional Jet service to 10 domestic destinations within Germany and 41 European destinations.

The Canadair Jet is in service or on order with airlines in Austria, France, Germany, Romania, Malaysia, Argentina, Canada and the United States, Bombardier said. Corporate versions of the aircraft operate with Xerox Corp in the United States and another unidentified customer, Bombardier said.
